description_expanded: Overview Highland Parks Coastal Retreat – Resort-Style Living Near 30A Beaches!The Space Highland Parks Coastal Retreat – Walk to Beach, Shops & Dining on 30AEscape to Highland Parks Coastal Retreat, a beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home located in the highly desirable Highland Parks community in Blue Mountain Beach. Perfect for families and groups, this spacious retreat offers resort-style amenities, an open-concept layout, and easy access to the beach, local restaurants, and boutique shopping along Scenic Highway 30A.Spend your days biking to the beach, relaxing by the community pool, or exploring nearby coastal towns. In the evening, unwind on the screened-in porch or gather with family for dinner and games.This home offers the perfect combination of comfort, location, and classic 30A charm. QUICK HIGHLIGHTS Quick Walk or Bike Ride to Beach Access – Enjoy the famous sugar-white sand and emerald waters of 30A Close to Shops & Restaurants – Minutes from popular Blue Mountain Beach dining and Gulf Place 4 Bikes Included – Cruise the scenic 30A bike path Golf Cart Available for Rent – $100 per night for easy beach trips and exploring 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Bathrooms – Spacious layout ideal for families and groups Open-Concept Living Area – Bright, comfortable gathering space Screened-In Porch – Perfect for morning coffee or relaxing evenings Resort-Style Community Pool & Amenities – Access to clubhouse and green space Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stainless appliances and generous prep space Dining Area for Shared Meals – Ideal for family dinners or game nights Garage & Driveway Parking – Easy arrival and unloading Outdoor Shower – Convenient after beach days Quiet Neighborhood Setting – Relaxing retreat close to everything Your Blue Mountain Beach GetawayWelcome to your coastal home away from home in Santa Rosa Beach. Located in the charming Highland Parks neighborhood, this thoughtfully designed home provides the perfect base for enjoying everything along Scenic Highway 30A.Step inside to find an open and airy living space filled with natural light. The living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and fully equipped kitchen, creating the perfect space to gather after a day at the beach.The first-floor primary suite offers privacy and convenience with a king bed and private en-suite bathroom. Upstairs, additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for kids, friends, or extended family.After a day exploring 30A, relax on the screened-in porch, cool off in the community resort-style pool, or take a bike ride to nearby restaurants and ice cream shops.Whether you're here for beach days, bike rides, sunsets, or great local dining, Highland Parks Coastal Retreat makes it easy to enjoy the best of 30A. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFirst Floor Primary SuiteKing Bed • Private En-Suite BathroomSecond Floor Guest BedroomKing BedSecond Floor Guest BedroomQueen BedSecond Floor Guest Bedroom / Flex RoomQueen Sleeper Sofa AREA ATTRACTIONS & LOCAL FAVORITESHighland Parks is centrally located along Scenic Highway 30A, placing you just minutes from some of the area’s most popular beaches, restaurants, and shopping spots.Guests love being close to Blue Mountain Beach and Gulf Place, where you’ll find boutique shopping, live music, coffee shops, and local dining.Popular nearby favorites include:• Stinky's Fish Camp – Famous for fresh Gulf seafood, oysters, and live music• Red Fish Taco – A lively local favorite known for fish tacos and margaritas• Blue Mountain Bakery – Perfect stop for morning coffee, breakfast sandwiches, and cinnamon rolls• Blue Mountain Beach Creamery – Homemade ice cream and sweet treats after a beach day• Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar – Gulf views, fresh oysters, and great sunset dining• The Perfect Pig Grill and Fish House – Popular brunch and coastal comfort foodNearby Gulf Place Town Center offers boutique shops, restaurants, art galleries, and seasonal events — making it a favorite gathering spot for visitors and locals alike.Outdoor lovers will also enjoy nearby Grayton Beach State Park, known for its scenic hiking trails, rare coastal dune lakes, kayaking, and paddleboarding.This location provides the perfect balance of peaceful neighborhood charm and easy access to the best of 30AShow less
